# Trixode Studios

> A research-led studio in Victoria, BC, Canada, building measurable, secure agentic systems. One brand, two destinations: Trixode Lab (research and engineering, https://www.trixode-studios.com/lab) and Trixode Creative.

## About

Trixode Studios is an AI agency based in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada. We build custom AI agents, high-performance websites, and AI-powered SEO systems for businesses in Victoria, Vancouver, and across British Columbia.

Founded by Hussien Ballouk, Trixode Studios combines AI engineering with applied business strategy to help companies automate workflows, capture more leads, and grow revenue using artificial intelligence.

## Trixode Lab

URL: https://www.trixode-studios.com/lab

Trixode Lab is the research and engineering arm of Trixode Studios (Victoria, BC). It studies the complexity and security of agentic systems and builds agent harnesses and agentic features on real products and research platforms.

Work shown on the Lab page:

- **Morphika** (https://morphika.ai): Trixode Studios' own agentic email product.
- **Intellicycle** (https://www.intellicycle.net/): Collaboration. An agentic marketplace for recycled metals; Trixode Lab helps build its agent harness and agentic features. Intellicycle is not a Trixode product.
- **Fixr**: Collaboration on a property and asset-operations platform.
- **Trixode OS**: the studio's in-house design system and tooling.
- **gemicro**: Claude Code skills and a command-line tool for the Electron Microscopy Research Group at the University of Victoria. It is the agent layer that runs on the group's ElectroSim computing platform. Microscope sessions, simulations, processing and compute jobs are recorded in a hash-chained ledger anchored to Morphika.
- **Physics simulations**: fusor-sim (ion dynamics in a Farnsworth fusor, https://www.trixode-studios.com/fusor-sim/fusor_sim.html) and donut-sim (tokamak magnetic confinement, https://www.trixode-studios.com/donut-sim/donut_sim.html), written in C++ with raylib and compiled to WebAssembly. Write-ups: https://www.trixode-studios.com/writing/star-in-a-jar and https://www.trixode-studios.com/writing/energy-donut

Lab pages:

- https://www.trixode-studios.com/lab (overview, research areas, work)
- https://www.trixode-studios.com/lab/workflow (six-step intake to describe an agentic workflow)
- https://www.trixode-studios.com/lab/contact (contact the Lab)

## Services

- **AI Agent Development**: Custom autonomous AI agents for business automation. Starting at $7,500.
- **AI-Powered Web Development**: Next.js websites with AI chatbots, lead capture, and sub-2-second load times. Starting at $4,999.
- **AI SEO & Content**: Predictive keyword strategy, AI-generated content, and revenue-tied reporting. Starting at $999/month.
- **Business Process Automation**: End-to-end workflow automation using multi-agent AI systems.
- **Enterprise Integration**: Connect AI systems to CRM, ERP, and existing business tools.
